description: Central Provincial Council - Notify the Co-operative Societies Statute No. 06 of 2018 of the Central Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new statute (Co-operative Societies Statute No. 06 of 2018) by the Central Provincial Council. It establishes a legal framework for the registration, administration, and development of co-operative societies, including provisions for appointments, registration conditions, and regulatory requirements. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves new legislation, regulatory frameworks, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
